Design quality

How often a model produces a design that survives an AlphaFold3 refold, scored for every model through one metric code path. MCSA: enzyme active-site scaffolding, motif RMSD native↔refold. DISCO: de-novo ligand binders, design↔refold self-consistency. Clustered counts distinct passing folds (Foldseek, TM 0.5), so a model cannot win by emitting the same success repeatedly.

Units

Aggregate — how consistently each model solves targets

Each box is the distribution of a model's per-target success rate (box = quartiles, line = median, whiskers = 1.5×IQR, dots = outliers). Wide box = uneven across targets.

Per-target breakdown

One row per target. The pale bar is every passing design; the solid bar inside it is the structurally distinct passes (Foldseek clusters). The gap between them is redundancy — passes that are copies of each other.

Dataset Models Sort

Speed & compute

Single-design (batch = 1) sampling on one H200, measured by the same harness for all three models. This is the cost of generating one design; it excludes the AF3 refold used to score it. Log-log — a straight line is a power law, the y-axis defaults to log (scaling exponents read as slopes); switch it to linear for absolute magnitudes. Curves stop where the model runs out of memory.
